meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或一段文案变成一支产品发布宣传片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上只有产品链接或一段文案,却要快速做出一支能直接投放的发布短片。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or a short brief into a launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if all you have is a product link or a brief but need a ready-to-post launch video.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把产品网址、粘贴的脚本或简报，按抓取素材、定设计系统、写分镜与脚本、逐帧搭建、渲染的顺序，做成一支产品发布/宣传视频，最终输出 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你提到要营销、发布、推广某产品，或给出一个商业网址时接管；网站导览/展示类请求也走这里，意图不明确则先转 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这个产品网址做成一支发布宣传视频
say.note: 会先抓取该网址的素材，再进入后续流程

帮这个 SaaS 新功能做一支揭晓视频

howto.what_en: After install, Claude turns a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video: it captures assets, sets a design system, writes storyboard and script, builds frames one by one, and renders renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Use when the user wants to market, launch, or promote a product, or gives a commercial URL. Site tours/showcases route here too; unclear intent goes to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this product URL into a launch video
say_en.note: It captures the site's assets first

say_en.text: Build a promo video from my pasted script
say_en.note: Your script is saved verbatim as user_script.txt
